summary: Completed comprehensive testing of Tickets Tab for Event Detail Module. All 9 backend API endpoints tested (21 tests passed). Full CRUD workflow verified: Create, Read, Update, Delete tickets. Additional features tested: Toggle Sales (Pause/Resume), End Sales, Duplicate ticket. Frontend UI fully functional with stats cards, ticket table, search, and all action dropdown options working correctly.
critical_code_review_comments: All Tickets Tab APIs properly implemented with validation and error handling
Soft delete implemented correctly - tickets with sold_count > 0 cannot be deleted
Toggle sales correctly prevents toggling on ended/sold_out tickets
Duplicate ticket creates copy with (Copy) suffix and resets sold_count to 0
Frontend correctly displays all ticket fields including new columns (ticket_type, category, min/max per order)
Stats cards update dynamically after ticket operations
seed_data_creation: Test tickets created and cleaned up during testing. Event ID 1 has 6 tickets: Early Bird, VIP Access, Early Bird (Copy), Student Discount, Early Bird (Copy), UI Test Ticket Updated
context_for_next_testing_agent: Tickets Tab module fully functional. All 9 ticket APIs tested: GET /tickets, GET /tickets/stats, POST /tickets, GET /tickets/:id, PUT /tickets/:id, DELETE /tickets/:id, POST /toggle-sales, POST /end-sales, POST /duplicate. Frontend displays stats cards, ticket table with all columns, search functionality, and action dropdown with Edit/Duplicate/Pause-Resume/End Sales/Delete options.

api_get_tickets_list.details: GET /api/events/:eventId/tickets returns list of non-deleted tickets with all fields

api_get_ticket_stats.details: GET /api/events/:eventId/tickets/stats returns totalSales, ticketsSold, totalCapacity, addonRevenue, avgOrderValue

api_create_ticket.details: POST /api/events/:eventId/tickets creates ticket with validation (name required, price required, no negative price)

api_get_ticket_by_id.details: GET /api/events/:eventId/tickets/:ticketId returns single ticket, 404 for not found

api_update_ticket.details: PUT /api/events/:eventId/tickets/:ticketId updates ticket fields, persists changes

api_delete_ticket.details: DELETE /api/events/:eventId/tickets/:ticketId soft deletes ticket (only if sold_count = 0)

api_toggle_sales.details: POST /api/events/:eventId/tickets/:ticketId/toggle-sales toggles is_on_sale and status, blocks on ended/sold_out

api_end_sales.details: POST /api/events/:eventId/tickets/:ticketId/end-sales sets status to 'ended' and is_on_sale to false

api_duplicate_ticket.details: POST /api/events/:eventId/tickets/:ticketId/duplicate creates copy with (Copy) suffix, sold_count=0, is_on_sale=false

frontend_stats_cards.details: 4 stats cards display: Total Sales, Tickets Sold, Add-on Revenue, Avg Order Value

frontend_ticket_table.details: Table displays all columns: Ticket Name, Type, Price, Sold/Capacity, Status, Sales Period, Actions

frontend_add_ticket_dialog.details: Add Ticket button opens dialog with all fields (name, description, price, capacity, category, min/max per order, sales dates, visibility, on sale toggle)

frontend_edit_ticket_dialog.details: Edit option opens dialog pre-filled with ticket data, Save Changes updates ticket

frontend_duplicate_action.details: Duplicate action creates copy and shows success toast

frontend_toggle_sales_action.details: Pause/Resume Sales toggles ticket sales status

frontend_end_sales_action.details: End Sales shows confirmation dialog, ends sales permanently

frontend_delete_action.details: Delete shows confirmation dialog, deletes ticket (disabled for tickets with sales)

frontend_search.details: Search filters tickets by name and category in real-time
